newsitem.title: SUDAN: Sudan asks U.S. to mediate with Eritrea.
newsitem.headline: Sudan asks U.S. to mediate with Eritrea.

text.p: Sudan has asked the United States to mediate in the dispute with eastern neighbour Eritrea, a senior Sudanese official said on Saturday.

Mostafa Osman Ismail, state minister at the foreign affairs ministry, also warned Eritrea that his country was losing patience with what it said was Asmara's support for Sudanese opposition groups based there.
"Sudan is ready to repulse any Eritrean attempt targeting its security or national sovereignity," he added.
"Sudan asked the United States to mediate to contain the differences between Sudan and Eritrea," Ismail said.
Sudan and Eritrea severed relations in 1994 after accusing each other of helping opposition groups.
